_readme: Edit this file to change the WhatsApp number, hours, delivery areas, fees or which restaurants are open. Money in cents (1295 = f12.95). Customers' phones read this file.
name: Pidi
payment: We take cash in florins or US dollars, or a bank transfer.
_status_help: status can be open, soon (shows 'Opening soon', can't order) or hidden (not on the home page; its own page says it isn't taking orders).
_fee_help: fee: a restaurant's delivery fee in cents (500 = f5). One order pays one delivery fee, the highest fee among the restaurants in it. deliveryFee is only used for a restaurant without a fee.
_minFood_help: minFood: the least food one order needs, in cents, before delivery (2400 = f24).
_eta_help: etaMin and etaMax: the usual delivery time in minutes. The site shows them as 45–60 min.
_hours_help: Each day is [opens, closes] in Aruba time. A closing time earlier than the opening time means after midnight. Customers only ever see when it opens.
_lastOrder_help: lastOrder: new orders stop at this time (Aruba time). It's never shown to customers. Remove the line for no cut-off.
_payWith_help: payWith: the ways to pay that customers tap at checkout; the choice goes on the WhatsApp ticket as "Pay: ...". Remove it to show only the payment sentence.
_payment_help: payment: one sentence on how to pay. With payWith it shows under the pay choices at checkout and in How ordering works.
_whatsapp_help: whatsapp: the WhatsApp number customers write to. A restaurant can have its own: add "whatsapp": "297..." to its line under brands.
_mix_help: mix: true lets customers put this restaurant's dishes in one order with the other mix restaurants, with one delivery fee.
